review_assessment.evidence: The added branch uses the existing runtime object only when model_prepare and writer are present. RuntimeClient.renew obtains CURRENT service authority, with inert_probe=True for READY and management=True for MANAGEMENT. InstanceService still checks owner, epoch, generation, Stop fence and shutdown under DB locks; the grant remains capped at 4.5 seconds and lease heartbeat at 5 seconds. No synthetic grant, new owner, reconnect or retry was added.

review_assessment.result: Existing serialization and fixed request budget remain intact.
review_assessment.evidence: status and renew use RuntimeClient.lock and the original stream; Host dispatch uses command_lock. Authority lookup remains outside the client lock, preserving the documented DB-to-runtime lock order. Background status/renew cannot overtake a managed exchange on this client. Host._managed captures its own request deadline; this patch does not refresh it. A state change between status and renew is revalidated at Host renewal; expired or non-READY/non-MANAGEMENT state refuses. This is source reasoning, not newly executed overlapping-transaction evidence.

Host renewal refuses when its existing deadline has expired, including before watchdog dispatch, and rejects STOPPING/STOPPED/UNCERTAIN. Stop revokes the management lifeline and, for held preparation, sets STOPPING before its first await; CLOSE is attempted once under stop_lock with uncertainty latched before transport. The QA success path sets done and joins heartbeat before service.shutdown; finally also sets done and observes heartbeat failure before retirement. No shield or cancellation catch was added to maintain_owner. Existing renew closes the client on BaseException and re-raises.

review_assessment.result: Original fail-closed cleanup behavior is retained.
review_assessment.evidence: A heartbeat/status/renew exception terminates the producer and is not suppressed into success. The outer finally records a heartbeat exception as cleanup_failed, then still attempts original Host retirement, exact resource readback, client/control close and engine disposal; unresolved effects retain the DB fence. New SOURCE cases close the RuntimeClient in finally, join Host clients/watchdog, and assert owned runtime.sock/runtime.boot absent. Their process and signal seams are mocked, so this is not native-process drain proof.
